name: Mage Tower v1 — Exterior vs Tutorial Island reference
subtitle: Two-storey ashlar tower under a steep pyramid spire with a crescent finial, corner quoins and a string course, lean-to timber scriptorium wing
review_note: The tower is the tallest silhouette on the headland after Lastlight and reads as a wizard's house at once: the steep slate spire and crescent finial, two rows of shuttered windows over a coursed stone shell with quoins, and the smaller timber wing tying it to the rest of the family. Doors sit under stone arches on the road sides. Held below 9.0: the ashlar courses are uniform in depth, the spire dormers are plain blocks, and the wing's lean-to meets the tower without a flashing or a chimney.
improve: Vary the ashlar depth and add a few dressed lintels, cut real dormer hoods into the spire, and give the wing a stone chimney and lead flashing where it meets the tower.
